summary: Completed comprehensive testing of RACCOON APP Admin Control Center. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI features verified successfully including Dashboard stats, User management, Reports, Premium, and Sessions tabs.

test_credentials.guest_user: No credentials needed - click Start Matching on /guest page

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Control Center fully functional with 5 tabs (Dashboard, Users, Reports, Premium, Sessions). Report button in Match.js only appears when matched with partner. Guest users see Access Denied for /admin.

admin_dashboard_stats.details: Dashboard shows Platform Overview with 7 stat cards (Total Users, Guests, Premium, Banned, Total Matches, Messages, Reports), Live Now indicator with online user count, Today vs Yesterday comparisons with percentage changes, and Alerts section

admin_users_tab.details: Users tab shows search bar, filter buttons (All, Premium, Banned, Guests), user list with avatars, premium/admin badges, and eye icon for viewing details

admin_user_detail_modal.details: Clicking user opens modal with stats (Matches, Messages, Reports, Days), user info (Country, Gender, Joined, Last Active, Sessions, Auth), and action buttons (Ban User, Grant Premium)

admin_reports_tab.details: Reports tab shows filter buttons (Pending, Reviewed, Actioned, Ignored) and displays pending reports with status badges

admin_premium_tab.details: Premium tab shows filter buttons (Active, Expiring, Expired) and lists premium users with expiry dates or 'Lifetime' badge

admin_sessions_tab.details: Sessions tab shows match history with View Chat button

report_button_in_chat.details: Report button implemented in Match.js chat header - only appears when matched with partner (as designed)

guest_admin_access_denied.details: Guest users see Access Denied page with shield icon, message 'You don't have permission to access the Admin Panel', and Back to Dashboard button

ban_system_with_duration.details: POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/ban works with permanent ban and duration options (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, custom)

premium_management.details: POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/premium works with duration options (7d, 30d, 90d, 365d, custom, lifetime)

TestAdminDashboard.test_dashboard_returns_today_vs_yesterda: PASS - Returns today, yesterday, and comparisons with percentage changes

TestAdminUserManagement.test_user_details: PASS - Returns user info and stats

TestAdminBanSystem.test_ban_user_with_duration: PASS - 24h ban works with duration message

TestAdminPremiumManagement.test_get_premium_users: PASS - Returns premium users with stats
